results.title: Hoi An lantern festival 2026: Dates & ultimate local guide
results.content:
Quick Answer: The Hoi An lantern festival 2026 falls on the fourteenth day of each lunar month, giving thirteen dates: 2 January, 1 February, 2 March, 1 April, 30 April, 30 May, 28 June, 27 July, 26 August, 24 September, 23 October, 22 November and 22 December 2026. It runs from roughly 6pm to 10pm, it is free, and there is no ticket. The Old Town closes to traffic, the electric street lighting is switched off at around 8pm, and floating lanterns go onto the Thu Bồn. The largest night of the [...] The 2026 events run across the Hội An, Hội An Đông and Hội An Ty wards, which is how the area has been divided administratively since Quảng Nam was merged into Đà Nẵng city in 2025. Expect Thiên Cẩu and lion dance competitions, a lantern procession with children carrying their own, mm cỗ displays, and performances on the square.

Đà Nẵng has also flagged an international lantern event in Hội An for September 2026, so the month may be heavier than a normal September. [...] October and November carry real risk. Those are the flood months, the boats stop running when the Thu Bồn is high, and the riverfront streets go under from time to time. It is worth chancing if the rest of your trip already puts you here, but I would not build anything expensive on top of 23 October.

## Getting Into Town on a Festival Night

The Old Town is closed to vehicles, so whatever you arrive in stops at the edge and you walk the last few hundred metres in.
